thread:
maria (customer): Hey, our production app started failing on calls to /v1/generate when we set response_format=json&strict=true. The client gets a JSON parse error.
alex (support): Sorry to hear that — can you paste the raw response body and the request headers you sent? also need the request id from the response headers if available.
maria (customer): here's the curl we use and the failing output:
```
curl -v -X POST 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer ***' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -H 'Accept: application/json' 
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
  -d '{"prompt":"summarize...","response_format":"json","strict":true}'
```
Response body that the client tried to parse:
```
<html>
<head><title>500 Internal Server Error</title></head>
<body>Unexpected server error</body>
</html>
```
Headers returned: `content-type: text/html; charset=utf-8`, `x-request-id: rq_9c3b2a`

alex (support): thanks — so the server returned HTML despite Accept header set to application/json. can you confirm there are no proxies or CDNs that might rewrite Accept? also which SDK/version are you using?
maria (customer): no proxies in front, direct traffic to our infra. using ruby client 1.2.3 (custom wrapper). we see this intermittently, ~5% of calls.
alex (support): hmm. two likely causes: 1) downstream service threw an error and the gateway fell back to an HTML error page; 2) header negotiation bug where Accept gets dropped for certain error flows. i'll loop in eng-runtime and request logs from the infra team. for now, workaround: set `response_format=structured` or remove `strict=true` so the client tolerates non-JSON. not ideal but helps.
eve (eng-runtime): pinged. quick question: do you have the full response headers for a failing request (from curl -i)? that x-request-id (rq_9c3b2a) helps — will pull the trace.
maria (customer): attaching output from `curl -i`:
```
HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error
Date: Tue, 11 Jun 2024 15:07:02 GMT
Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8
Content-Length: 128
X-Request-Id: rq_9c3b2a
Server: redwood-gateway

<html>...</html>
```

alex (support): ok we have enough to triage. escalation: labeling P2 — structured-output enforcement causing client-side failures. adding reproduction steps and the x-request-id to the ticket.
eve (eng-runtime): found related log entries: upstream model process crashed for rq_9c3b2a and our gateway error handler returned an HTML error page instead of the JSON error envelope. regression introduced in gateway v2.14.0 where Accept header was not propagated on error paths. working on a patch.
alex (support): thanks eve. maria — temporary mitigation: (1) set Accept: application/json explicitly (you already do), but also add `Accept-Profile: response_format=json` header per docs; (2) disable strict parsing client-side until we confirm fix; (3) if you can, add retry on 5xx with backoff.
maria (customer): thanks. can you estimate timeline for a fix? this breaks our app when strict mode is on.
eve (eng-runtime): target: hotfix rollout within 2 hours to restore Accept propagation on error handler, then a follow-up release to add unit tests. will post deploy-bot message when live.
deploy-bot: deploying gateway hotfix v2.14.1 -> prod in 30s :rocket:
eve (eng-runtime): hotfix deployed to prod, rolling update done. monitoring for 10m.
alex (support): maria — can you retry a few requests and confirm you no longer see HTML on failures?
maria (customer): just tested 20 requests with strict=true, all returned JSON error envelopes or proper responses. no HTML. very relieved :relieved:
alex (support): great — leaving ticket open for 48h to monitor, will follow up with postmortem and SDK guidance (we'll document Accept-Profile header and recommend a graceful strict mode fallback). please re-open if you see recurrence.
maria (customer): thanks everyone, appreciate the quick turnaround!
